description: Linear SVM finds a maximum-margin hyperplane separating classes in sparse TF-IDF space. It uses the squared-hinge loss with one-vs-rest multi-class decoding. C controls the margin/loss trade-off. Variant of the SVM family (see models/svm/config.json).
input_features: Sparse word unigram/bigram TF-IDF (max_features=60000, min_df=2, max_df=0.99, sublinear_tf=True). Kept sparse throughout — no dense conversion.
selection_rule: Max mean macro F1 on fixed group-respecting CV folds (development data only)
artifact_note: Fitted development pipeline saved to models/svm/linear/artifacts/{protocol}/ (model.joblib + vectorizer.joblib + metadata.json).
